preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.
The target value must be an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] if node is not None) and all(1 <= node.left.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] if node is not None and node.left is not None) and all(1 <= node.right.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] if node is not None and node.right is not None)
preconditions.description: All node values in the tree must be integers between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value == mirror_node and mirror_node is not None)
postconditions.description: The function returns the value of the mirror node of the target if it exists; otherwise, it returns -1.

postconditions.expression: mirror_node is None or (mirror_node.val == target and mirror_node != target_node)
postconditions.description: The mirror node is defined as the node in the opposite subtree at the same depth as the target node, with the left and right children swapped recursively.

postconditions.expression: target_node is not None and target_node.val == target
postconditions.description: The target node must exist in the tree with the given target value.
